login.title: Member login for research and operations.
login.description: Sign in securely to manage submissions, view program details, and access the MissileX analytics network.
login.panelDescription: Enter your organisation credentials or sign in with Google to continue. Verified users gain access to research programs, mission analytics, and secure file submissions.
login.secureAuthDesc: Email login, Google Sign In, password recovery, and verification workflows are supported.

register.title: Create your research portal account.
register.description: Register with your organisational email to access collaborative defence research workflows and secure project submission tools.
register.panelDescription: Create an account to submit projects, review mission progress, and collaborate on secure defence research initiatives.

forgotPassword.title: Recover access to MissileX.
forgotPassword.description: Use your registered email to receive a secure password reset message and continue to the research dashboard.
forgotPassword.panelTitle: Reset your access to the research portal.
forgotPassword.panelDescription: Enter your registered email and we will send secure instructions to restore your account access.

requireAuth.defaultDescription: This feature is available to registered MissileX members. Sign in or create a free account to continue.
requireAuth.dashboardTitle: Sign in to view your dashboard
requireAuth.dashboardDescription: The operations dashboard, project approvals, and admin tools are available to signed-in MissileX members.
requireAuth.profileTitle: Sign in to view your profile
requireAuth.profileDescription: Your profile, account status, and saved research projects are available once you sign in.
requireAuth.researchTitle: Sign in to submit a research project
requireAuth.researchDescription: Project submission is available to registered researchers and students. Sign in or create a free account to submit your work.
